# T-1 Android enroll sample: do they have landing page IP overlap?
mysql --defaults-extra-file=~/.dc-platform/secrets/my.cnf.prod -N -e "
WITH enroll AS (
  SELECT app_id, uid, event_id, ip, event_time
  FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
  WHERE r.dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'android'
    AND r.attribution_flag = 1
    AND (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel,''))) IN ('organic','natural','self') OR TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel,''))='')
    AND r.uid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enroll) AS android_enroll,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id)
   FROM enroll e
   JOIN dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d c
     ON e.app_id=c.app_id AND e.ip=c.ip
    AND c.dt BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND c.event_time < e.event_time
    AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.event_time, e.event_time) <= 86400
    AND c.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.channel)<>'' AND LOWER(c.channel)<>'organic'
  ) AS with_click_cand;
"

-- task: dws_register_attribution_result_d
-- doc: 注册归因 ETL（mvp_v2）；入围=四条件，不关联安装；打分回落 default；不靠 is_run 开算
-- 频率: daily
-- 调度: wf_dws_汇总_日
-- params: 无（分区/业务日按调度日 T-1 自动渲染）
-- 幂等: INSERT OVERWRITE 当日分区（T-1）
-- 上游: dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2, dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d/view_d, dim 配置表
-- ============================================================
--
-- 渠道回写：is_rewrite_channel=1 时由 dim_user_attribution_channel_apply_d 写 dim.dim_user_all.channel + dim.dim_user_daily_snapshot.channel
-- rewrite_status：apply 阶段写 1/0；识别阶段在 INSERT 写 rewrite_reason
-- 入围（2026-11-28 起含 Android；其余同 2026-09-12）：仅四条件
--   iOS/Android + 自然渠道（organic/natural/self/空）+ uid 非空 + register.attribution_flag=1
--   不关联安装事件，不判断 install.attribution_flag
--   打分与门槛沿用 iOS（default：设备分 brand10/model20/system20/version20；时间分 40/30/20/10；门槛 40）
-- 不再用 dim_app_attribution_config.is_run 过滤计算；is_run 不回写

INSERT overwrite dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d PARTITION (p$[yyyyMMdd-1]) (
    dt, app_id, uid, register_event_id, register_event_time,
    attributed_channel, source_event_id, source_event_type, source_event_time,
    score, score_brand, score_model, score_system, score_system_version, score_time,
    score_threshold, confidence_level, attribution_status, unattributed_reason,
    time_diff_seconds, time_bucket_max_seconds,
    reg_ip, reg_brand, reg_model, reg_system, reg_system_version,
    hit_ip, hit_brand, hit_model, hit_system, hit_system_version,
    rule_version, rewrite_status, rewrite_reason, created_at
)
WITH reg_enroll AS (
    SELECT
        r.dt,
        r.app_id,
        r.uid,
